_note: The owner asked (2026-09-28): 'חייב לדאוג ל sitemap כמו שצריך לכל השפות'. Shopify builds the sitemap itself; this records the check of every URL in it, in Hebrew, English and Arabic, and what was fixed. Checked on SportWear (next), the theme the owner is about to publish. Products, prices, stock and statuses were not touched.

sitemap.languages: One index for the three languages: Hebrew at the root, then /en/ and /ar/ child sitemaps (products in two files, collections, pages). /en/sitemap.xml and /ar/sitemap.xml do not exist (404): submit only the root index.

crawl.how: scratchpad crawler: every URL of the 15 child sitemaps fetched on SportWear (next) (preview cookie), about 2.5 pages a second; status, <html lang/dir>, canonical, hreflang links, robots meta, <title>, meta description, first h1. Flagged pages fetched again after each fix.
crawl.template_checks: All 5,328 answer 200 with the right lang and dir, a canonical to themselves, and hreflang links to he, en, ar and x-default (Shopify adds them through content_for_header). No Hebrew text on /en or /ar pages, no Arabic on Hebrew pages.
found: Meta description of 1,097 Hebrew product pages (and many en/ar ones): with no SEO description of their own, Shopify's is the description with its paragraphs glued: 'Detroit Pistons #2 Basketball Jersey – Blue | Red Side StripesSizes: S, M, L, XL.'
Page title cut at 70 characters mid-word on long titles, also when the title has an apostrophe ('Kids''): '… Retro, Pins – SportWear'.
15 collections without any description (the categories and leagues: nba, premier-league, la-liga…): no meta description in any language.
Empty pages in the sitemap: the collections frontpage (Shopify's default), basketball-sets, sale, euroleague, israeli-basketball-league, and the empty blog 'news', each in three languages.
Share image alt text in Hebrew on /en and /ar pages; the English home description was 198 characters.

theme.what:
A product page without its own meta description in the page's language gets one rebuilt from its description, a sentence per paragraph or list item (split at '

', ''), the title's ' | detail' read as ', detail', cut at a word before 160 characters. Whole page titles (page_title compared with its entities decoded). og:image:alt in the page's language. Shorter English home description.

hidden_from_search_engines._note: Metafield seo.hidden = 1 (number_integer): the page leaves sitemap.xml in all three languages and gets <meta name=robots content=noindex,nofollow>. It stays reachable by link. When a collection gets products, delete its metafield (metafieldsDelete) so it comes back.

items.why: Shopify's default 'Home page' collection; only the demo product, which is on no channel
0 products until a product gets a compare-at price: unhide it when a sale starts

hidden_from_search_engines.not_linked: None of them is linked from the menus or the home page (checked on SportWear (next), he and en).

collection_seo_descriptions._note: The 12 collections with products and no description got an SEO description (collection seo.description, Hebrew) and its en/ar translations (translationsRegister, key meta_description; digest = SHA-256 of the Hebrew). Search results only: the collection page shows no new text.
